shortDescription: Manage the software update settings of a BIG-IP

options.name: auto_check
options.description: Specifies whether to automatically check for updates on the F5 Networks downloads server.

options.name: auto_phone_home
options.description: Specifies whether to automatically send phone home data to the F5 Networks PhoneHome server.

options.name: frequency
options.description: Specifies the schedule for the automatic update check.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.
